search_log: Searched "Atmosphere Taylor Jenkins Reid excerpt publisher first chapter" and opened Penguin Random House's 35-page authorized sample.
Searched "Atmosphere Taylor Jenkins Reid point of view third person narration" and opened explicit POV descriptions from LitCharts, BookRags, and SuperSummary.

Searched "Atmosphere Taylor Jenkins Reid narrator third person review" and checked whole-book review descriptions for possible alternating-person structure; none reported first- or second-person base sections.
Searched "Atmosphere Taylor Jenkins Reid Google Books excerpt"; the Google Books page supplied bibliographic and synopsis material but no usable sustained preview.

Searched targeted phrases including "my mom said that if I was going to be proud of myself"; results reproduced the quotation without enough surrounding text to resolve its speaker, so q09804 remains locally unclear.

Checked AP's review and the official Penguin Random House product page; both verified the work and supplied short prose or synopsis material, but neither added stronger whole-book POV evidence than the sources recorded above.
person_note: The controlling narration is close third person, primarily aligned with Joan and occasionally with Vanessa. Numerous interior Goodreads passages externally name Joan or refer to her as she while presenting her thoughts and perceptions, agreeing with the sustained authorized opening and three explicit whole-book or structural descriptions. First-person forms in the dataset are overwhelmingly dialogue, clipped speech, universal reflection, or—in q09800—the publisher sample's signed author's note; they do not form autonomous first-person story sections. Generic you passages are likewise gnomic or free-indirect generalization rather than second-person narration. The only residual uncertainty concerns attribution of a few clipped individual quotations, not the book-level person, and no credible source indicates alternating base narration.
